messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Spike in 502 / timeout rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (hosted). Error rate +18% over baseline, 90th latency 2.1s. Paging oncall.

maria (oncall): I'm on it, thanks inc-bot. any idea if this is widespread or a subset of customers?

kevin (sre): I'm seeing ingress 502s at the gateway level. A bunch of upstream 504/timeouts too. Snapshot shows a surge starting ~18:27 UTC.

tara (eng-runtime): Can you paste a sample request id or logs? trying to trace across runtime.

kevin (sre): attaching quick tail but note we have sampling low on traces so may not have spans.

kevin (sre): ```
2026-03-15T18:29:12Z gateway-1 INFO "POST /v1/generate" status=502 backend="runtime-pool" latency=1203ms host=gw-usw2-01
2026-03-15T18:29:12Z gateway-1 INFO "POST /v1/generate" status=502 backend="runtime-pool" latency=1189ms host=gw-usw2-02
2026-03-15T18:29:13Z gateway-2 WARN "no request-id header" from=10.3.2.45
```

kevin (sre): problem: a large fraction of requests lack X-Request-ID and there are very few traces because sampling = 0.01 in prod. we don't have cross-service correlation for many hits.

maria (oncall): ugh. that explains why we can't see KV cache misses / long tail in runtime. we need stopgap instrumentation to get request-ids and more logs, but careful about log volume.

ollie (support): Customer-facing note: we have multiple customers reporting timeouts in the last 10m. I'm drafting an incident message but need a clear scope. Which regions/customers affected?

kevin (sre): seems concentrated in us-west-2 hosted endpoints. Could be gateway saturation or a runtime regression. Errors from both model A and B. Not just a single customer.

tara (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation options: 1) increase trace sampling to 0.2 temporarily, 2) enable HTTP debug logs on gateway pods for 15 minutes, 3) inject a lightweight request-id middleware at edge to guarantee header, 4) scale gateway to absorb burst. I can open a quick PR for middleware but we can hotpatch a sidecar while PR lands.

sanjay (platform): I'm on scaling. will spin up +2 gateway replicas and increase HPA target by 2x now.

kevin (sre): to enable debug logs without deploy:```
# set env on gateway deployment (short-lived)
kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/gateway DEBUG_HTTP=true --record
# increase trace sampling feature flag in configmap
kubectl -n observability patch configmap obs-config -p '{"data":{"trace_sample_rate":"0.2"}}'
```

maria (oncall): Kevin, do it but keep an eye on log retention/cost. set a timer to revert in 15m.

kevin (sre): ack. patching now. toggling sampling to 0.25 for better coverage. will schedule revert at +15m.

deploy-bot: deploy/gateway image:v2.6.1 patched env DEBUG_HTTP=true (revision r234)

kevin (sre): also creating a temporary envoy filter to add X-Request-Id if missing. quick patch:```
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: EnvoyFilter
metadata:
  name: inject-request-id-temp
  namespace: gateway
spec:
  # lightweight header-injecting filter, short ttl
```
(we're using the platform's filter API, will apply and then remove)

tara (eng-runtime): I'll standby to collect runtime logs once request-ids flow through. please curl test with header to validate.

kevin (sre): test command I'm running: ```
curl -v -H "X-Debug-Trace: 1" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

kevin (sre): initial tests show a few requests now have injected ids. sample linked:```
{"timestamp":"2026-03-15T18:31:05Z","request_id":"r-8f3a","status":502,"backend":"runtime-1","latency_ms":1250}```

ollie (support): Writing customer note: "We are investigating elevated error rates for API requests in us-west-2. Engineers are collecting additional logs and enabling temporary diagnostics; we will update in 30 minutes." any objections?

maria (oncall): fine. add that we're working on mitigation and that we're not seeing data exfiltration. reassure customers.

tara (eng-runtime): FYI runtime teams: if you see workloads with spikes in redis or worker queue times, call it out. we suspect KV cache misses causing backend backpressure.

kevin (sre): Observability gap summary (for postmortem):
- root cause unknown (investigating)
- missing request-id header on many requests => loss of distributed tracing correlation
- low trace sampling rate in prod => small fraction of spans captured
- logs present at gateway but sparse on runtime due to missing IDs
Stopgap actions taken:
- increased trace_sample_rate -> 0.25
- enabled DEBUG_HTTP on gateway pods (15m window)
- applied temporary request-id injector via Envoy filter
- scaled gateway replicas +2

maria (oncall): timeline & next steps: monitor for 30m after patches. if error rate drops to baseline, revert DEBUG_HTTP and Envoy filter, keep trace sample at 0.05 (higher than before) and open a shadow-tracing rollout. tara will lead runtime investigation into KV cache churn. kevin will draft postmortem notes and instrumentation ticket to ensure request-id is mandatory at edge. ollie will send initial customer update.

tara (eng-runtime): starting root cause runbook: collecting runtime logs keyed by new request_ids, capturing heap/disk/queue metrics for runtime pods, looking for surge in cold starts or GC.

kevin (sre): note for postmortem: add a remediation item to fail closed on missing request-id (i.e., generate one at gateway) and ensure tracing sampling auto-boosts on error spikes.

ollie (support): posted initial customer message to status page and emailed top 5 impacted accounts.

maria (oncall): Good work. leave incident channel open. I'll update in 30m or sooner if status changes. :thumbsup:

inc-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-4823. Pager duty alerts acknowledged by maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): closing temporary actions checklist: DEBUG_HTTP revert timer set, Envoy filter remove scheduled, gateway scale in 30m if stable. Monitoring window started 18:33 UTC.

kevin (sre): last note — we should add an infra test that validates every request through gateway has X-Request-Id and a trace header. adding ticket.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone, keeping this thread live for updates.
